# Victor's Mexican Food

Victor's Mexican Food is a family-rooted Mexican restaurant in Palm Desert, California, located at 74600 CA-111 Suite F. The restaurant serves fresh Mexican food inspired by Victor's Zacatecas and Jalisco roots, including tacos, burritos, breakfast favorites, combination plates, fresh salsas, dine-in, takeout, and online ordering.
